hooks.command: _bl_session_child() { p=""; cancelled=0; interrupted=0; trap 'cancelled=1; interrupted=1; if [ -n "$p" ]; then kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || :; fi' HUP INT TERM; "$@" <&3 3<&- & p=$!; if [ "$cancelled" = 1 ]; then kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || :; fi; while :; do interrupted=0; child_rc=0; wait "$p" || child_rc=$?; if [ "$child_rc" -le 128 ] || [ "$interrupted" = 0 ]; then break; fi; done; trap - HUP INT TERM; if [ "$cancelled" = 1 ]; then exit 0; fi; return "$child_rc"; } 3<&0; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; if [ "${BUILD_LOOP_NATIVE_HOOKS:-}" != off ] && [ -x "$r/bin/native/bl" ] && { read -r a < "$r/bin/native/bl.sources"; } 2>/dev/null && { read -r b < "$r/crates/SOURCES.digest"; } 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$a" = "$b" ]; then _bl_session_child "$r/bin/native/bl" hook session-start --root "$r" 2>/dev/null; rc=$?; case "$rc" in 75|126|127) if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then _bl_session_child python3 "$r/scripts/session_start_hook_command.py" --fallback "$r" 2>/dev/null; else printf '{}'; fi;; esac; else if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then _bl_session_child python3 "$r/scripts/session_start_hook_command.py" --fallback "$r" 2>/dev/null; else printf '{}'; fi; fi; exit 0

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.build-loop/state.json" ]; then r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; s=75; if [ "${BUILD_LOOP_NATIVE_HOOKS:-}" != off ] && [ -x "$r/bin/native/bl" ] && { read -r a < "$r/bin/native/bl.sources"; } 2>/dev/null && { read -r b < "$r/crates/SOURCES.digest"; } 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$a" = "$b" ]; then { "$r/bin/native/bl" hook trace --workdir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --phase start >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; } 2>/dev/null; fi; case $s in 0) ;; *) python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/tool_trace.py" --workdir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" hook --phase start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; fi

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.build-loop/state.json" ]; then r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; s=75; if [ "${BUILD_LOOP_NATIVE_HOOKS:-}" != off ] && [ -x "$r/bin/native/bl" ] && { read -r a < "$r/bin/native/bl.sources"; } 2>/dev/null && { read -r b < "$r/crates/SOURCES.digest"; } 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$a" = "$b" ]; then { "$r/bin/native/bl" hook trace --workdir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --phase end >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; } 2>/dev/null; fi; case $s in 0) ;; *) python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/tool_trace.py" --workdir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" hook --phase end >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; fi

root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; s="$root/scripts/hooks/session_end_retro_sweep.py"; tp=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("transcript_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$tp" ] && [ -f "$s" ]; then nohup python3 "$s" "$tp" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi; exit 0
